news_articles.title: Neoen announces Ako Battery, its first big battery in Japan.
news_articles.snippet: Neoen is collaborating with French company, Equans, and Japanese company, Toho, on this project and obtained a grid connection agreement with the network operator, Kansai Electric Power Co., in January 2026.

news_articles.title: Citilink introduces Token Transit mobile validators on buses, partners with Equans to implement its NAVINEO CAD/AVL solution
news_articles.snippet: In addition to the Token Transit mobile validators on its buses, Citilink is partnering with Equans to implement its NAVINEO Computer Aided Dispatch/Automatic Vehicle Location (CAD/AVL) solution, anticipated for summer 2025.

news_articles.title: Bouygues Group to acquire Equans from Engie in €7.1bn deal — Financier Worldwide
news_articles.snippet: Through the acquisition of Equans, Bouygues intends to create a world leader in multi-technical services, anchored in France.
